verdicts.m2Target: the analytic gap is precisely: (1.2) beyond theta = 1/2. The 1/2 barrier is named and real; the escape mechanisms (degree, arithmetic, twists) are the active frontier (PRZZ's open question is exactly the degree/truncation balance); the leading work says of theta=infinity 'we are very far away'. A genuine attempt is a research-risk unit; faking the asymptotic is forbidden.
verdicts.m6Lane: the 2026 proportion-certificate family is STRUCTURALLY BLIND to off-line structure: the spectral-twin construction reproduces the certificate's data at every depth with a third of the zeros off the line. Like zero-density (0285) - which was compatible with the sparse face by sparseness - the proportion-certificate lane is compatible with the sparse face BY CONSTRUCTION (the twin/chain configurations ARE certified-equivalent to on-line configurations). No face-shrinking power. The lane is AUDITED and CLOSED as a face-closer (not as a mathematical statement - its proportion results stand).
verdicts.modelCaveat: the twin/chain corollaries (Props 2-4) are proved IN THE MODEL (indicator window, untruncated frame, periodic configuration); the source states: 'Restricting to T < gamma <= 2T, truncating the frame to 0 <= k < d, and smoothing phi as in [2] change the data. We expect the change to be lower order, but we do not prove it.' Theorem 1 (the exact Gram-matrix identity) holds for the true frame windows (any phi supported in an interval of length L); the density-inferiority corollary carries the model caveat. Recorded exactly.
